headline: Man City chairman on club's Premier League charges case: 'Nothing has changed'
description: Manchester City chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak has said "nothing has changed" regarding the club's ongoing legal battle with the Premier League.

headline: Rodri: You cannot take away Manchester City's achievements
description: Rodri: You cannot take away Manchester City's achievements

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Liverpool eye winger Kevin Schade
description: Arsenal and Liverpool are upping their interest in Brentford's Kevin Schade, while the rest of Europe chases center backs. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man City verdict will leave a stain and stench on a Premier League era
description: Manchester City are expected to be found guilty of almost all 115 financial charges against them. It means an era of English soccer is now tarnished with multiple asterisks.

headline: Rio Ferdinand leads reaction to Man City's 115 breaches case: 'Another Premier League medal'
description: The football world has been reacting to reports that Manchester City are expected to be found guilty of most charges in their legal battle with the Premier League.

headline: Man City charges: Premier League clubs seeking legal advice amid expected guilty verdicts - sources
description: Premier League clubs are seeking legal advice amid an expectation that Man City have been found guilty of hundreds of breaches of financial regulations, sources told ESPN.
